phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Production code needs robust error handling.**

**Error handling principles:**

| Principle | Why |
|-----------|-----|
| Custom error types | Domain-specific errors |
| User-friendly messages | Good UX |
| Context | Help debugging |
| Recovery | Graceful failures |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Production code handles errors gracefully. Users deserve clear error messages."

**Best practices:**
| Practice | Why |
|----------|-----|
| Use custom errors | Domain-specific |
| Use `eprintln!` | Error output |
| Provide hints | Help users |
| Log errors | Debugging |
phase1.openingDialogue: Production error handling. Robust and user-friendly. 🦀

phase2.explanation:
You need to handle Result values properly.

**The fix:**
```rust
match risky_operation() {
    Ok(value) => println!("Result: {}", value),
    Err(e) => eprintln!("Error: {}", e),
}
```

**Rust-chan says:**
"Never ignore Result. Always handle it."
